overview: The Medford School Committee received news of a 10-year NEASC reaccreditation for the high school, rejected participation in the state school choice program, and tabled a proposed school meal price increase. The committee also reviewed a student robotics innovation, summer offerings, and pre-budget reports for mathematics, physical education, and English language learners.

items.title: Approval of Minutes, Bills, and Payrolls
items.summary: Approved the previous meeting minutes, bills, transfers, and payrolls.

items.title: Report on High School NEASC Accreditation
items.summary: Superintendent Belson announced that Medford High School and Medford Vocational Technical High School received full 10-year reaccreditation from NEASC.

items.title: Silvio Cella Foundation Donation
items.summary: Accepted a $3,000 grant from the Silvio Cella Family Foundation to fund uniforms, equipment, and clinics for the high school football program.

items.title: MVTHS Extended Day and Evening Programs
items.summary: Approved an adult continuing education evening program and an eighth-grade summer exploration program at the vocational technical high school.

items.title: Report on Vocational School Robotics Project
items.summary: Electrical student Hunter Raymond demonstrated a telepresence robot he built to allow electrical teacher Rich Cormio to instruct classes remotely during medical leave.

items.title: Proposed School Lunch Price Increase
items.summary: Tabled a proposed price increase of 50 cents for breakfast and 25 cents for lunch pending further financial breakdown and comparative district data.

items.title: School Choice Program for 2015-2016
items.summary: Voted to reject participation in the state school choice program for the upcoming school year.

items.title: Pre-Budget Report: Mathematics
items.summary: Mathematics Director Carolyn Joy presented curriculum updates, enrollment impacts on the four-year math requirement, and requests for document cameras and elementary instructional materials.

items.title: Pre-Budget Report: Health and Physical Education
items.summary: Lead teacher Rachel Perry reported on health curricula, pool integration, and staffing needs for an adaptive physical education teacher and elementary health instruction.

items.title: Pre-Budget Report: English Language Learners
items.summary: Coordinator Leslie Trotter outlined rising enrollment, curriculum initiatives, and budget requests for software, updated placement assessments, and an additional elementary teacher.

items.title: Report on Summer Programs
items.summary: Accepted a report detailing seven district summer offerings, including relocation of the Summer Fun Program to Medford High School to utilize the pool.

items.title: Condolences and Superintendent Announcements
items.summary: Approved four condolence resolutions, and Superintendent Belson provided facility updates and scheduled upcoming committee meetings and budget hearings.
